items.title: 3.5 Atomic orbital hybridization aur molecules ki shaklein (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.5, printed page 61.

blocks.text: Hybridization woh process hai jis mein thori mukhtalif energy aur shape wale atomic orbitals aapas mein mil kar (mix ho kar) naye orbitals ka set banate hain, jin ki energy bhi ek jaisi hoti hai aur shape bhi ek jaisi.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein (Keep in Mind)
blocks.text:
• Hybridization ek hi atom (ya ion) ke orbitals ka milna hai.
• Sirf woh orbitals mil sakte hain jin ki energy ek doosre ke qareeb ho.
• Jitne orbitals milte hain, utne hi hybrid orbitals bante hain.

blocks.prompt: Carbon ka 2s orbital aur 2p orbitals hybridize ho sakte hain, lekin 1s orbital un mein shamil nahi hota. Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Sirf qareebi energy wale orbitals milte hain. 2s aur 2p ki energy qareeb hai, is liye woh mil kar barabar hybrids banate hain; 1s orbital energy mein un se bohat neeche hai aur waisa hi rehta hai.

items: Hybridization ek atom ke qareebi energy wale orbitals ko utni hi tadaad ke barabar energy aur shape wale hybrid orbitals mein badal deti hai.
